gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-prompt: Prompt has oversized small letters and open apertures that read easily, in a friendly sans-serif way. Prompt sits under Coming Soon, whose pen-and-paper handwriting keeps one constant stroke thickness while the body stays quiet.
gen-gf-courier-prime-archivo: Archivo has curves that open outward and a commanding x-height. Courier Prime's fixed-width, typewriter beat runs across the top, and the plain sans below breaks that rigid rhythm with broad, confident lowercase.
gen-gf-courier-prime-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Courier Prime spaces every letter on a fixed-width beat, like code. Be Vietnam Pro follows with strokes like bent steel rod and a high mean line, so the structured top gives way to something smoother underneath.
gen-gf-courier-prime-work-sans: Courier Prime ticks along with fixed-width, code-style letters that never thin out into calligraphy. Work Sans then brings a modern sans with a high mean line and c tips that keep their distance, a looser, more contemporary stride.
gen-gf-cousine-archivo: Cousine isolates every glyph in generous blank space. Archivo underneath has a commanding x-height and curves that open outward, so the typewriter-style heading hands off to a body with far more presence.
gen-gf-cousine-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Crisp, typewriter-tidy, and a bit austere. Cousine is best at precise, isolated glyphs with a tall waist line, while Be Vietnam Pro, a plain sans, does its best work in smooth, bent-rod curves that never crowd.
gen-gf-cousine-fs-ranade: Precise yet organic, this pairing swings between extremes. Cousine does best at spaced, typewriter-like glyphs of equal width, whereas Ranade, a sans-serif, excels at gently shifting weight and widely spaced lines that loosen the text.
gen-gf-cousine-montserrat: Montserrat reads wide and friendly, with oversized e and a counters. Cousine does best at precise, isolated typewriter letters, while Montserrat, a sans-serif, is best at gliding lines with generous space before each curve.
gen-gf-crafty-girls-fs-rowan: Rowan reads literary and friendly, its curves generously open. Make Crafty Girls small, though, and its twine-like handwriting strokes lose some of their relaxed, unclosed charm against the text serif.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-fs-karma: Delius Unicase never tapers or hairlines, just relaxed handwriting with a tall x-height. Karma, a classic serif, then carries a longer read with gently varied strokes and a modulation that never snags the eye.
